title: Efficient Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning-Based Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.12796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) improves speech intelligibility in noisy environments but often relies on computationally expensive models unsuitable for resource-constrained edge devices. This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-driven neural architecture search (RL-NAS) framework to discover compact, efficient AVSE architectures. The search space preserves temporal alignment between audio and visual streams, while a novel reward function jointly optimises speech enhancement performance, measured by SI-SNR improvement, and model compactness. Using proximal policy optimisation with constraint-aware action masking, the framework evaluates only 35 candidate architectures and identifies a model with 2.9 million parameters, compared with 22 million in the baseline. The proposed architecture achieves a 14.5 dB SI-SNR improvement, only 0.7 dB below the baseline, while reducing model size by approximately nine-fold. Evaluation on

translated_title: 基于强化学习神经架构搜索的高效视听语音增强
translated_abstract: 视听语音增强（AVSE）能够改善嘈杂环境中的语音可懂度，但通常依赖于计算开销高昂的模型，不适合资源受限的边缘设备。本文提出了一种由强化学习驱动的神经架构搜索（RL-NAS）框架，用于自动发现紧凑、高效的视听语音增强架构。该搜索空间保持了音频流与视觉流之间的时间对齐，同时通过一种新颖的奖励函数联合优化语音增强性能（以SI-SNR提升来衡量）与模型紧凑度。借助带有约束感知动作掩蔽的近端策略优化，该框架仅评估了35个候选架构，便找到一个参数量仅为290万的模型，而基线模型参数量为2200万。所提出的架构实现了14.5 dB的SI-SNR提升，仅比基线低0.7 dB，同时将模型规模缩减了约九倍。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的神经架构搜索框架，通过联合优化语音增强性能与模型紧凑度，自动搜索出参数量约为基线九分之一（290万 vs 2200万）而SI-SNR性能仅降低0.7 dB的高效视听语音增强模型，适合资源受限的边缘设备部署。
